name: REPACHOLI, Dan

headline.note: Trade employment, Tefol and Double R line boring, explicitly full-time MTW work and Double R branch management are documented. Follow-up supplies 2010 Double R entry, late-2011 Rio Tinto entry, Rutherford workplace and separate union/podcast activity. MTW’s September 2017 transfer to a state-controlled group requires payroll/control allocation; the entire mine spell cannot safely remain classified private. Precise dates, leave and other ordinary hours remain unresolved; no headline totals calculated.

career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen Parliamentary Handbook records fitter work from 1997 to 2009. Repacholi's first speech identifies D&H Rodwell Tooling as his apprenticeship employer and says he spent 10 years with the business; a later government speech says he maintained production lines at Ford and Toyota, without establishing whether those companies or D&H Rodwell held the employment contract. The year range and 10-year narrative do not resolve exact dates, hours, leave or breaks.
career_spells.counting_note: The private employer and substantive trade work are supported, but year-only boundaries and missing full-time evidence prevent an exact duration calculation.

career_spells.evidence_note: The 2024 trade-press profile identifies Tefol and Double R as employers during line-boring work before MTW. The existing 2009 date describes entry to the mining industry, not a proven Tefol appointment boundary. Exact Tefol dates and workload remain unknown; Double R’s separately documented spell is now recorded separately.
career_spells.counting_note: No duration is counted without an identified employing entity, bounded dates and substantive full-time evidence.

career_spells.employer: Double R Pty Ltd trading as Double R Equipment Repairs (payroll entity unresolved)
career_spells.role: Line borer; helped establish line-boring division
career_spells.evidence_note: In the 2019 first-person interview he dates entry to 2010 and subsequent Rio Tinto commencement to late 2011. End year follows that described job transition, not a precise last working day; overlap and leave unresolved. The 2024 profile independently names both Tefol and Double R.
career_spells.counting_note: Year-level boundaries and unknown ordinary hours do not support an exact full-time total.

career_spells.employer: Rio Tinto / Mount Thorley Warkworth; operation acquired by Yancoal in September 2017 (payroll entity unresolved)
career_spells.role: Mine operator; dispatch officer; trainer; union delegate
career_spells.evidence_note: First speech expressly supports full-time employment and operator, dispatch and trainer duties. The 2019 interview explicitly dates Rio Tinto entry to late 2011, describing six years; the later seven-year narrative is approximate and conflicting, not used to back-calculate a start. Frozen mining cessation remains December 2017. Mine ownership changed from Rio Tinto to majority state-controlled Yancoal on 1 September 2017. Mixed denotes changing control across this combined spell, not a stable joint public/private employer. Payroll identity, personal transfer and cessation dates, leave and grade changes remain unresolved; union delegate duties are separately excluded. The31October2024 government transcript explicitly identifies him among direct full-time Rio Tinto employees, as distinct from labour-hire colleagues. This resolves direct versus agency employment for the described Rio period, but not the exact legal subsidiary or post-acquisition transfer. His separate sporting account establishes unpaid leave occurred somewhere in his career; it cannot be assigned wholesale to this spell. His original 27 September 2022 first speech expressly describes a 12.5-hour operator shift, corroborated in his July 2024 trade interview. This is an individual shift length, not a weekly roster or proof of uninterrupted full-time service; shift frequency, leave allocation and employer-control split remain unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Full-time status supported, but employer/control allocation needs resolution across the 2017 acquisition. Do not classify the entire interval as private or derive exact years from approximate durations.

career_spells.employer: Double R Pty Ltd trading as Double R Equipment Repairs (payroll entity unresolved)
career_spells.role: Hunter Valley branch manager, Singleton then Rutherford
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen Parliamentary Handbook records manager work from December 2017 to December 2021. Repacholi says Double R founder Rusty Russell recruited him at the end of 2017 to manage a new Singleton engineering shop and describes growth from about 15 to more than 70 employees over four years. The ABR identifies the private Australian company Double R Pty Ltd as operator of the registered Double R Equipment Repairs business name from 16 May 2014; that establishes the operating entity, not Repacholi's personal payroll company. Exact appointment and cessation days, hours, leave and any campaign-related reduction are unresolved. The 2019 first-person interview identifies the branch-manager title and relocation to Rutherford; September 2017 is the branch opening, not his proven appointment month. Shooting Australia confirms work at Rutherford by July 2020 and training outside work, without ordinary hours or leave terms. A publicly indexed LinkedIn profile displays October 2017 to 'Present'; its start conflicts with the frozen December 2017 record and its stale open-ended display conflicts with the documented December 2021 end, so neither boundary is adopted. Original2019 PDF now directly verified: describes quotation/office administration, customer visits and staff management, supporting active operational duties beyond title. Its5:50 start time does not establish weekly hours. September2017 remains branch-opening evidence, not his personal appointment boundary.
career_spells.counting_note: Month boundaries and employer classification are supported, but the manager title and four-year narrative do not independently prove substantive full-time hours throughout the interval.

career_spells.evidence_note: Repacholi says he represented Australia from 1998 across five Olympics and four Commonwealth Games and refers to a first sponsor, while the Australian Olympic Committee and ABC document the sporting career. The sources do not establish a continuous employment relationship, salary, sporting hours or employer control; his first speech says shooting was not financially appealing. Shooting Australia’s2July2020 interview explicitly includes unpaid leave and missed work among his sporting costs. It also describes sporting retirement after London2012, return before Glasgow2014, retirement after Gold Coast2018 and later return for Tokyo. These are sporting breaks, not proven job exits; exact employment leave intervals remain unknown. Original2019 Double R profile includes Repacholi among corporate sponsorship recipients. Sponsor identity is supported; payment amount, contract, sporting-work dates and employment status remain unknown.
career_spells.counting_note: Elite sporting participation and sponsorship are visible but excluded because no substantive paid employment relationship is established.

career_spells.evidence_note: ABC described Repacholi as Labor's candidate by 28 September 2021, and election records establish his election on 21 May 2022. The exact endorsement day, remuneration, workload and overlap with Double R through December 2021 are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Party candidacy and campaigning are excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.role: Member of the House of Representatives for Hunter
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen roster, current Parliament listing and ABC election record establish House service from the 21 May 2022 election.
career_spells.counting_note: Federal elected office is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.employer: Mine union at Mount Thorley Warkworth (organisation and payroll arrangement unresolved)
career_spells.evidence_note: First speech and 2024 interview identify delegate duties during the MTW period. No separate appointment dates, union salary, release time or hours are documented; do not count alongside mining work as additional full-time years.
career_spells.counting_note: Excluded category; not added to public/private employment headlines.

career_spells.employer: Dan & The Doctor podcast (creator credited as Dan Repacholi MP; contractual employer unknown)
career_spells.role: Creator and co-host with Gordon Reid MP
career_spells.evidence_note: Producer catalogue credits Repacholi and Reid and dates programme activity to 2023–2025. Contract boundaries, preparation hours, remuneration and sponsorship are unstated; concurrent with parliamentary service.
career_spells.counting_note: Media activity is not presumed to be paid private employment; no headline years calculated.

research_notes: Obtain payroll or employer records for D&H Rodwell Tooling, including apprenticeship commencement/completion, full-time hours, leave, breaks and whether Ford and Toyota production-line work was performed as a D&H employee or under separate employment.

Identify the travelling line-boring employer and exact 2009 transition into Mount Thorley Warkworth; obtain the mine payroll entity, appointment date, grade changes, hours, leave and December 2017 cessation date.

Obtain Double R appointment and cessation records, substantive hours and leave, and resolve whether campaign activity from September 2021 changed employment status before the recorded December 2021 end.

Determine whether Australian shooting representation, grants or sponsorship ever constituted paid substantive employment; current evidence supports participation and sponsorship but not an employment relationship. Resolve campaign remuneration and the January–May 2022 employment gap.

2026-10-01 follow-up resolves formerly unnamed line-boring employers, separates Double R 2010–2011 from Tefol with unknown boundaries, adds late-2011 MTW commencement, Rutherford relocation, separate delegate and podcast activity, and historical mine-control evidence.

Searched trade-press historical interviews, public professional profile, employer and sporting-body records, apprenticeship/full-time terms and historical mine-acquisition accounts. A 5:50 daily start in the interview is not a normal weekly-hours statement. No reliable apprenticeship dates, ordinary Double R hours, sporting paid-leave arrangements or January–May 2022 employment found.

Resolve the 2019 six-year and later seven-year mine narratives using personnel records. Preserve December 2017 frozen cessation and branch-opening versus appointment distinction. Obtain precise payroll identity across 1 September 2017 before splitting private versus state-controlled service. Yancoal is not presumed privately controlled merely because listed. No shared methodology changed.

Follow-up leads: Tefol and Double R historical staff material, employment disclosures and appointment records, Rio Tinto/Coal & Allied transfer documents, union delegate release terms and podcast remuneration. The 2019 trade PDF direct open returned content-length error 14983779; indexed first-person passage available, issue date/page still needs direct verification.

Second follow-up2October2026 resolves direct Rio Tinto employment versus labour hire for the period recalled in a government transcript and records explicit unpaid-leave evidence overlooked in the earlier sporting source. Do not attribute the separate speaker’s contractor salary/lack-of-entitlement account to Repacholi. Unpaid leave and sporting retirements prevent assuming uninterrupted work or sport; exact dates/employer allocation remain necessary for calculations. Targeted apprenticeship, Rodwell, Tefol, Double R and public-profile searches did not resolve ordinary hours or exact boundaries. Mine acquisition/control caveats remain. No headline years changed.

Third follow-up3October2026 identifies Double R Pty Ltd as the private entity operating the Double R Equipment Repairs business name before the documented manager spell. This improves employer identity but does not prove the personal payroll contract. A legitimately public LinkedIn search-index excerpt reports Hunter Valley Branch Manager from October2017 to 'Present'; because this conflicts with the frozen December2017–December2021 history and appears stale, it is recorded as a discrepancy only. No hours, leave, campaign reduction, mine-transfer payroll allocation or exact employment boundary was resolved; headline totals remain null.

Fourth follow-up4October2026 used exact Rodwell, fitter/machinist, Tefol and Double R branch-manager queries rather than repeating broad biography searches. Results returned the already recorded first-speech account of ten years with D&H Rodwell, the known line-boring/mining chronology and the stale LinkedIn branch-manager excerpt. A social-media result suggesting sponsorship associated with Double R was not an employer or payroll record and was not adopted. No apprenticeship boundary, Ford/Toyota contracting identity, Tefol interval, Double R appointment, ordinary hours, leave or campaign reduction was established; these avenues now require employer/personnel material rather than another exact-name web search.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Recovered and rendered the complete original2019 trade interview, resolving the previously logged content-length gap. Verified active Double R operational duties and its named shooting sponsorship; no weekly hours, paid sporting employment or appointment boundary inferred. Brodie Amaro’s adjacent apprenticeship/night-shift account is a different speaker and excluded. New Rodwell Tooling Contractors ABN79005699776 lead appears to match the business name but no personal payroll or contemporaneous linkage established; not substituted as proven employer.

2026-10-05 targeted follow-up: Original first speech and July2024 interview explicitly establish 12.5-hour operator shifts; added to mine evidence without converting shift length into weekly hours or dates. New Rodwell Tooling Contractors/Tefol/2011 queries across both search engines returned first-speech derivatives, known chronology and unrelated sources, no personal payroll linkage. MEU May2022 leave statement concerns Russell Robertson, not Repacholi; no campaign leave inferred. APH Hansard find returned Internal Error/no matching text, recovered through authorised original member transcript. Employer/control and unpaid sporting-leave allocation remain unresolved.
